name: CRUD Layered Architecture (Preset)
description: A lightweight layered architecture for simple CRUD. Suitable for scenarios with simple business rules, no complex state transitions, and mostly data maintenance.

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.responsibility: Receives requests, validates parameters, returns responses; does not carry business logic

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.responsibility: Use-case orchestration, transaction boundaries, DTO conversion; calls domain/service layers

layers.name: Data Access Layer
layers.responsibility: Persistence, queries, repository implementation; shields database details

code_requirements: Each maintained object maps to one Controller + Service + Repository
Separate DTO from Entity; never expose Entity directly to the frontend
Query conditions, list fields, create/edit/delete rules must match crud_spec_card one-to-one
Permission checks are handled uniformly in the application layer
Validation rules are defined centrally and reused by frontend and backend
